Q: Today is the last day of the first quarter of 2008. What is the date 24 hours later in MM/DD/YYYY?
Options:
(A) 04/01/2008

(C) 03/31/2008
(D) 04/01/2007
(E) 04/01/2063
(F) 03/22/2008
A:
action.label: context

action.content:
The first quarter of any year consists of January, February, and March. Therefore, the last day of the first quarter of 2008 is March 31, 2008.

The question asks for the date 24 hours later. Adding 24 hours to March 31, 2008, brings us to the very next day, which is April 1, 2008.

In MM/DD/YYYY format, this date is 04/01/2008.

Comparing this to the options:
(A) 04/01/2008 - Matches.
(B) 01/17/2008 - Incorrect.
(C) 03/31/2008 - This is "today," not 24 hours later.
(D) 04/01/2007 - Incorrect year.
(E) 04/01/2063 - Incorrect year.
(F) 03/22/2008 - Incorrect.

A: (A)
